newsitem.title: USA: Owen Healthcare subsidiary names president.
newsitem.headline: Owen Healthcare subsidiary names president.

text.p: Owen Healthcare Inc said Tuesday that Tom Bang has been named president of its MediTROL subsidiary.
Bang replaces John Sackett, who left the company in December of 1995, said Owen Healthcare Executive Vice President Stephen Drury, who has been acting as interim president of MediTROL.
Bang was previously executive vice president of sales and marketing for Reuters Health Information Services, the company said.
He is scheduled to join the company October 7.
